steps.description: The file is checked against 50+ case rules. Missing documents and mismatched amounts are flagged before filing, not after a query.

steps.name: Organise

steps.name: Digistamp

content.headline: Questions hospitals
content.intro: Something we haven’t covered? Write to info@dualite.dev and a person will answer.

items.question: Which schemes and claim types do you support?
items.answer: ECHS and RGHS, for both OPD and IPD claims. Each scheme’s own rules decide the page order, which pages get a seal and signature, and what the portal needs.

items.question: Does Dualite submit claims without our approval?
items.answer: No. Claims are saved as drafts on the portal, and every file passes a human review gate. Your operator approves and submits. Anything unusual is held until someone on your team has looked at it.

items.question: Do we need to change how we scan?
items.answer: No. Your team keeps scanning the way it does today. The only addition is a dated folder for each day, so that day’s scans are saved together. The watcher picks them up from there, around the clock.

items.question: What happens when a document is missing or doesn’t match?
items.answer: The file is flagged with the exact page and the rule it failed. For example, a medicine billed on page 7 but missing from the claim. Your team fixes it before filing, instead of after a query.

items.question: Where is our patient data stored?
items.answer: We don’t save your documents. Dualite processes each file and keeps only log data, for 55 days, after which it is deleted automatically. That data is held on our secure servers, is not shared with any third party, and can only be viewed by your organisation. Your data is never used to train AI models.

items.question: How do we know a claim has actually been paid?
items.answer: Dualite reconciles every claim across three sources: its status and approved amount on the scheme portal, the bill in your hospital management system, and the credits in your bank account, matched by UTR. Your dashboard shows which claims are paid in full, short-paid or approved but not yet credited.

items.question: How long does it take to go live?
items.answer: We start with a 2–3 week pilot on your own claims. During the pilot we learn how your claims desk works (your schemes, documents and review steps) and set Dualite up around it. Once it’s running the way you need, we move to full deployment.
